title: A JSON schema Is not an AI governance layer
summary: The AI governance argument is happening one layer above the code that actually stops your agent.
llm_summary: The article argues that using a JSON schema to validate an AI’s inputs or outputs is not true governance—it’s just a static check that sits above the code but never actually stops a misbehaving agent.
